title: Turkish Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with lively ingredients, perfect for a quick snack or meal.

ingredients.name: Lively Wrap
ingredients.notes: Choose a flavorful wrap for the base of the dish

ingredients.name: Turkish Rice
ingredients.notes: Use leftover rice or cook according to package instructions

ingredients.name: Lively Filling
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite lively ingredients, such as hummus, tabbouleh, or pickled vegetables

instructions: Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds to make it more pliable.
Spoon the cooked rice onto the center of the wrap.
Add your chosen lively filling on top of the rice.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
